Alongside Matron Shellene, she cares for children who have lost their families to the relentless conflicts troubling the kingdom. She also enlists trusted Alliance adventurers to mentor and inspire her young wards during Children's Week. Standing watch just outside the orphanage south-east of the Cathedral of Light, Orphan Matron Nightingale tends to Stormwind's most vulnerable survivors. Recent wars, gnoll rampages, and the rise of the Defias Brotherhood have left many children without homes or parents. Nightingale and her fellow caretaker, Matron Shellene, provide these youngsters shelter, basic care, and guidance beneath the watchful eye of the Church of the Holy Light.

Osric Strang. Osric Strang is a veteran armor merchant who operates Limited Immunity, a shop situated in Stormwind's Old Town. Specializing in heavy mail and plate, he supplies sturdy gear and shields to Alliance defenders and weary travelers passing through the capital. Tucked away in the weathered streets of Old Town, Osric Strang manages Limited Immunity, a shop catering to frontline fighters in need of heavy armor and shields. While his wares are suited for standard soldiers and traveling adventurers, he often assists incoming couriers who need a point of contact when arriving in the capital from nearby settlements like Westfall's Sentinel Hill.

Overlord Mok'Morokk. Overlord Mok'Morokk is the brute chieftain of the Stonemaul ogres, presiding over Brackenwall Village in Dustwallow Marsh. Originally appointed by Rexxar for his strength, he has become a tyrannical and cowardly ruler who refuses to defend his clan against the black dragonflight. When Rexxar bested the previous chieftain Kor'gall and led the Stonemaul clan in defense of Durotar, he left Mok'Morokk in command, seeing promise in his sheer martial strength. That faith proved misplaced. Mok'Morokk quickly succumbed to the corrupting influence of absolute authority, ruling through intimidation and self-indulgence rather than stewardship. Instead of caring for his kin, he demands unearned tribute, lounges in Brackenwall Village, and bullies anyone who questions his command.

Overlord Ramtusk. Overlord Ramtusk is a massive quilboar warlord who leads the warriors deep within Razorfen Kraul. Crying out for victory and for Agamaggan, he fights at the head of his elite guards, and striking him down shatters the martial backbone of the Kraul's defenders. Overlord Ramtusk holds command deep within the thorny maze of Razorfen Kraul, the quilboar stronghold in the southern Barrens. He goes into battle with a war cry to the boar demigod Agamaggan, and he rules the Kraul's fighters with unyielding authority.

Ozzie Togglevolt. Ozzie Togglevolt is a gnome engineer and survivor of Gnomeregan's fall, currently operating out of the snowy village of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Haunted by the tragedy that struck his people, he works alongside his partner Razzle Sprysprocket to research a remedy for the irradiated leper gnomes. Ozzie Togglevolt was inside the subterranean wonders of Gnomeregan when catastrophe struck. When the toxic fallout was vented throughout the corridors to stem the trogg invasion, Ozzie stood right beside his fellow gnome, Gnoarn. A sudden radioactive discharge struck Gnoarn directly, altering him forever before Ozzie's eyes. Though Ozzie made it to the surface alive and reached the haven of Dun Morogh, the horrifying memory of that disaster never left him.

Pao'ka Swiftmountain. Pao'ka Swiftmountain is a young tauren naturalist stranded among the wild wyverns of Highperch in Thousand Needles. Having traveled south under the guidance of Motega Firemane, his youthful curiosity got the better of him when he ventured too close to a nesting site and ended up cornered in the cliffs. Pao'ka came to the canyon country of Thousand Needles alongside Motega Firemane, eager to catalog and study the dangerous beasts of the canyons. His father had been reluctant to let his son go on such a perilous journey, and Pao'ka's recent misadventure proves those concerns were warranted. Fascinated by the magnificent wyverns inhabiting Highperch, the young scholar crept up the mountain trail behind a solitary tauren totem. Unsurprisingly, the territorial beasts took offense to his intrusion, driving him deep into the crags where he found himself trapped and terrified, unable to slip past the swooping predators to return to Whitereach Post.

Parqual Fintallas. Parqual Fintallas is a Forsaken scholar and former human historian of Lordaeron, currently residing in the Undercity's Apothecarium. Despite the grim surroundings of his undead existence, he retains a polite demeanor and an enduring passion for ancient lore, often assisting travelers sent to consult his deep historical expertise. In life, Parqual was a respected human scholar of Lordaeron who knew all there was to know of the kingdom, immersing himself in historical texts. When the plague of undeath struck, Parqual was among the many citizens slain and raised, only to eventually break free under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. While the Forsaken largely embrace cold pragmatism and turn away from their former lives, Parqual retains his scholarly passion and pleasant manners, still seeking enlightenment, though of a different nature than in life.

Pelturas Whitemoon. Pelturas Whitemoon is a night elf father dwelling in Astranaar whose young daughter, Relara, has been struck by a terrible, corrupting illness. Desperate to save her, he works closely with local herbalist Orendil Broadleaf and traveling Alliance champions to gather sacred remedies from the surrounding wilds. His quest to heal Relara takes adventurers into some of Ashenvale's oldest sacred groves and ruins. Residing in the serene boughs of Astranaar, Pelturas Whitemoon lives the quiet life typical of forest-dwelling Kaldorei, often venturing out with his young daughter Relara to collect shimmering moonstones around Fallen Sky Lake. However, when Relara falls critically ill with a mysterious affliction, his quiet world collapses into frantic desperation. Astranaar is besieged on many fronts, but for Pelturas, nothing in the great forest matters more than saving his child.

Pilot Bellowfiz. Pilot Bellowfiz, affectionately known as 'Fizzer,' is a dwarven driver stationed at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. As a member of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, he is responsible for maintaining and fielding heavy dwarven war machines, specifically his own siege engine, Jetsteam. Stationed just outside the bustling halls of Ironforge at Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz represents the mechanical backbone of the dwarven military. Piloting the powerful siege engine known as Jetsteam, Bellowfiz spends his days tuning components, procuring essential parts, and keeping his machine battle-ready. Alongside his comrade Pilot Stonegear, Bellowfiz is constantly discussing vehicular designs, armor plating, and engine output, ensuring that the mountain kingdom's mechanized firepower remains unmatched across Khaz Modan.

Pilot Hammerfoot. Pilot Hammerfoot is a dwarven siege engine pilot of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, stationed near the mountain passes connecting Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Worried for a fellow pilot lost in the hills, he seeks willing adventurers to search for his friend. His presence highlights the dangers faced by dwarves along the high alpine ridges. Ironforge's siege engines are the pride of its Siege Brigade, but driving them across harsh mountainous terrain carries extreme risk. Stationed at the North Gate Outpost overlooking the border between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan, Pilot Hammerfoot guards the pilots' engines and watches the mountain passes. When a pilot goes missing, finding him quickly becomes a priority, especially with savage beasts prowling the nearby hills.

Pilot Longbeard. Pilot Longbeard is a dwarven siege engine pilot of the Ironforge Siege Brigade, stationed in the Hall of Arms within Ironforge's Military Ward. Though posted in the mountain city, he maintains close ties with gnomish tinkerers and fellow racing enthusiasts operating far away in the Shimmering Flats. Found amongst the martial displays and weaponsmiths of Ironforge's Military Ward, Pilot Longbeard represents the proud siege engine corps of Khaz Modan. While his duties keep him within the fortress city, Longbeard keeps an eager ear out for innovations and news from fellow mechanics across the continent, including the Brassbolts brothers tinkering out on the salt flats of Kalimdor.

Pilot Stonegear. Pilot Stonegear, nicknamed 'Stone', is a dwarf mechanic and driver in the Ironforge Siege Brigade stationed at Steelgrill's Depot. He operates the formidable siege engine known as Trollplow and works tirelessly to enhance its performance and armor. Adventurers traveling through Dun Morogh often help him secure rare materials to keep his war machine battle-ready. Stationed among the rumbling boilers and clanking tracks of Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Stonegear serves Ironforge as a proud driver in the Siege Brigade. His pride and joy is Trollplow, a heavy siege tank built to smash through enemy lines. Stonegear takes his machine seriously—knowing that in the heat of battle, a driver's life depends entirely on the resilience of gears, plates, and steam pressure. He constantly seeks to fine-tune both Trollplow's combat efficiency and the everyday livability of its cramped cockpit.

Pixel. Pixel is an enterprising goblin courier operating out of Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Making her living delivering heavy goods across dangerous territories, she handles shipments like Warsong saw blades for the local Horde forces—though she never lets any cargo go without proper compensation. While Splintertree Post serves as a fortified bastion for the Horde amidst the hostile canopies of Ashenvale, Pixel remains firmly focused on profit. As an independent courier willing to haul freight into active war zones, she provides essential logistics for the Warsong Clan's logging efforts. However, true to goblin custom, contracts and coin dictate her cooperation. She holds fast to her deliveries until the client produces payment; for the saw blades, she wants a deadly blunderbuss to protect herself on the road. Always alert to an opportunity, she also pays passing adventurers for satyr horns, which are in high demand in Ratchet.

Piznik. Piznik is a disgruntled goblin surveyor hiding deep within Windshear Mine in the Stonetalon Mountains. Once a high-ranking overseer in the local Venture Company operations, he was sidelined by the ruthless Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle. Now nursing a grudge, Piznik secretly gathers intel to undermine his former workplace. Before Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle seized supreme authority over Windshear Crag, Piznik held the enviable title of second-in-command across the entire operation. However, corporate restructuring in the Venture Company is unforgiving. Once Gerenzo took full control, Piznik found himself pushed aside and relegated to the murky depths of Windshear Mine. Rather than accepting his demotion quietly, Piznik bides his time underground, keeping a watchful eye on mine movements and quietly plotting revenge against the boss who demoted him.

Pozzik. Pozzik is an esteemed goblin tinkerer and racer stationed at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. Once one of the most respected engineers in Undermine, he now dedicates his technical genius to constructing experimental rocket cars and settling the ultimate debate of engineering supremacy against his gnome counterpart. Before retiring to the harsh salt flats of Thousand Needles, Pozzik built a legendary reputation among the goblins. As one of the most respected tinkerers out of Undermine, his technical expertise spans complex internal combustion, propulsion, and hazardous chassis construction. Rather than settling into comfortable obscurity, however, Pozzik took his mechanical mastery into the desert to push high-speed machinery far past its breaking point.

Priestess A'moora. Priestess A'moora is a devout night elf servant of the Moon Goddess residing within the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Working closely under the guidance of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind's priesthood, she attends to rituals of spiritual purification and communion with Elune. Travelers exploring Teldrassil are often directed to her when matters involve sacred offerings and the mystical wildlife of the boughs. Within the serene marble halls of the Temple of the Moon, Priestess A'moora spends her days in contemplation and service. As an ordained priestess of Elune, she assists in tending the spiritual needs of Darnassus and preserving the delicate rituals passed down through millennia. While much of the Sisterhood oversees military defenses or diplomacy, A'moora focuses on traditional devotions and sacred matters concerning the natural spirits of Teldrassil.

Priestess Alathea. Priestess Alathea is a night elf priest trainer residing within the tranquil halls of the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Devoted to the Moon Goddess, she guides novitiates in the sacred arts and racial blessings bestowed by Elune. Her teachings help night elf practitioners attune their minds to defensive prayers and celestial magic. Standing within the soaring silver heights of Darnassus's grandest sanctuary, Priestess Alathea serves the Sisterhood of Elune as an instructor and spiritual guide. As night elf initiates progress beyond the quiet boughs of Shadowglen, they are directed to the Temple of the Moon to deepen their covenant with the Goddess. Alathea stands among the priestesses ready to impart sacred knowledge to those who dedicate their lives to healing, warding, and divine light.

Priestess Anetta. Priestess Anetta is a human cleric of the Holy Light stationed inside Northshire Abbey. As a member of the Brotherhood of Northshire, she instructs newly arrived priests in their first sacred rites. Priestess Anetta can be found on the ground floor of Northshire Abbey within its quiet library wing. Amid the threat of Defias bandits and kobolds troubling the valley, she serves as a grounding presence for the Brotherhood of Northshire, reminding all who pass not to turn their backs on the Light, for it may be the one thing that saves them someday.

Priestess Josetta. Priestess Josetta is a human priest trainer stationed on the upper floor of the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. Dedicated to guiding novices of the Holy Light beyond their initial trials in Northshire, she mentors young priests in faith, devotion, and practical ministry. While many who take holy vows spend their days within grand cathedrals or cloistered monasteries, Priestess Josetta ministers directly among the common folk of Elwynn Forest. From her modest quarters upstairs in the bustling Lion's Pride Inn, she attends to the spiritual health of travelers, guards, and local laborers alike, demonstrating that service to the Holy Light requires presence wherever hearts need solace.

Prospector Ironband. Prospector Darteus Ironband is an honest, hardworking dwarven surveyor who oversees an archaeological dig in southeastern Loch Modan. Working under the banner of the Dwarven Explorers' Guild, he is determined to uncover the earthen heritage buried beneath Khaz Modan. Despite setbacks and hostile local creatures, Ironband remains committed to sending regular progress reports and uncovered relics back to Ironforge. Darteus Ironband leads the dig at Ironband's Excavation Site nestled in the hills of southeastern Loch Modan. Like many field researchers in the Explorers' Guild, Ironband believes that the soil of Khaz Modan hides vital truths about the origins of the dwarven race. His camp works tirelessly digging trenches and sifting through rubble in search of ancient relics, stone tablets, and earthen artifacts. Despite the slow pace of unearthing buried history, Ironband's resolve remains unshaken, and he is always eager to recruit competent adventurers to safeguard his operation.

Prospector Remtravel. Prospector Remtravel is a dwarven archaeologist affiliated with the Explorers' League, stationed deep in the gloomy woodlands of Darkshore. He oversees an excavation site unearthing ancient relics, though his scattered focus and perilous surroundings leave him in constant need of assistance. Sent far across the sea by the Explorers' League, Prospector Remtravel established his dig site along the southern reaches of Darkshore. While the night elves are often protective of their ancestral territories, the League's insatiable drive to uncover the origins of Azeroth pushes prospectors into every forgotten corner. Remtravel's work unearths fossilized history and ancient stones, but the aggressive native wildlife and hostile local threats make managing a frontier dig almost more than one scatterbrained dwarf can handle.

Prospector Ryedol. Prospector Ryedol is an Explorers' League surveyor stationed on a dusty rise overlooking the eastern Badlands. Watching over the perilous excavations below, he strives to recover lost dwarven relics and maintain hope in a barren wasteland overrun by troggs and beasts. Perched upon a rugged hill just south of Hammertoe's Digsite, Prospector Ryedol represents the ongoing efforts of Ironforge's Explorers' League in the Badlands. The arid valley is rich in ancient titan secrets and earthen heritage, but field expeditions here are constantly beleaguered by savage troggs, ravenous coyotes, and territorial drakes. Ryedol coordinates retrieval efforts for dwarven gear stolen by the Dark Iron dwarves and seeks signs of hope amid the ruined outposts, determined not to let the League's sacrifices in the wastes be in vain.

Prospector Stormpike. Prospector Stormpike is a blunt, short-tempered dwarf stationed within the Library of the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. A member of the renowned Stormpike clan, he oversees logistical support for distant archaeological digs and lends his sharp intellect to deciphering coded missives. Tucked away amid the towering bookshelves of the Hall of Explorers, Prospector Stormpike coordinates excavation efforts across Khaz Modan and beyond. Despite his gruff demeanor and impatience with idle chatter, he is deeply dedicated to uncovering dwarven history, keeping distant sites supplied with essentials like blasting powder. Beneath his rough exterior lies a keen analytical mind skilled at breaking intricate ciphers, making him an unexpected asset to Alliance scouts dealing with clandestine threats.

Prospector Whelgar. Prospector Whelgar is a dwarven archaeologist stationed at an excavation site in the Wetlands east of Menethil Harbor. His mission to uncover titan relics has stalled after vicious raptors overran the dig. He now seeks hardy adventurers willing to brave the beasts to recover ancient artifacts. Sent into the marshy wilderness of the Wetlands to unearth the history of the dwarven race, Prospector Whelgar established an archaeological camp known as Whelgar's Excavation Site. The valley was once rich with ancient stone relics, but the local raptors quickly grew territorial and drove his team into hiding. Despite the danger, Whelgar refuses to abandon his duty. He remains focused on recovering valuable relics—including the enigmatic Goaz Stone—before wild predators or rival scoundrels ruin the site entirely.

Quartermaster Lewis. Quartermaster Lewis is a human supply merchant stationed at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Serving the local People's Militia, he provides rations, ammunition, and everyday provisions to travelers and defenders attempting to hold the frontier against the Defias Brotherhood. Perched inside Sentinel Tower, Quartermaster Lewis manages the meager logistical lifeline of the Westfall militia. With Stormwind's royal leadership offering little aid to the impoverished region, Sentinel Hill relies on local volunteers and whatever supplies they can gather. Lewis distributes standard field necessities, from dry rations and fresh water to arrows, shot, and throwing blades, ensuring the fighters standing watch have the bare essentials to survive Defias raids.

Quinn Yorick. Quinn Yorick is a wounded Forsaken scout sheltering on the upper floor of a ruined farmhouse in the Ivar Patch. Having barely survived an encounter with the ghoul known as Ivar the Foul, he now relies on passing allies to help secure his survival. Tucked away inside an abandoned home at the Ivar Patch, Quinn Yorick lies gravely injured upstairs. His condition is the result of a vicious clash with Ivar the Foul, a ghoul lurking in the farm's barn in the northern stretches of Silverpine Forest. Sent with his sister Rane to scout Silverpine and report to High Executor Hadrec, Quinn cannot finish his mission or safely retreat alone, so he remains in hiding while travelers working for the Forsaken bring him healing and deal with the creature that nearly tore him apart.

Raene Wolfrunner. Raene Wolfrunner is an accomplished Sentinel officer and hunter stationed at the heart of Astranaar in Ashenvale. Accompanied by her loyal wolf and saber cat companions, she coordinates defense efforts across the forest against encroaching Horde forces and corrupted furbolg tribes. She serves as a vital anchor for Alliance champions striving to protect the sacred wilderness. Raene Wolfrunner stands watchful in Astranaar alongside her trusty saber cat Korra and wolf Dagri. As an officer among the Sentinels, she oversees patrols throughout Ashenvale and coordinates intelligence reaching beyond its borders, dispatching scouts like Kaela Shadowspear into neighboring regions such as the Stonetalon Mountains.

Ragnar Thunderbrew. Ragnar Thunderbrew is a dwarven brewer and co-owner of the renowned Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Known across Dun Morogh for serving his family's signature Beer Basted Boar Ribs, he works constantly to keep the busy tavern stocked and its patrons satisfied. Standing inside the Thunderbrew Distillery at Kharanos, Ragnar Thunderbrew manages the establishment's culinary reputation alongside his family's brewing operations. The distillery is a central gathering place for local mountaineers, traveling adventurers, and gnome refugees fleeing Gnomeregan. Chief among his duties is preparing the family's renowned Beer Basted Boar Ribs, a hearty Dun Morogh specialty cooked with stout dwarven ale. However, maintaining steady supplies has become difficult; his usual meat provider enlisted in the King's Army, leaving Ragnar dependent on wandering mountaineers and hunters to keep fresh crag boar flanks coming into the kitchen.

Rahauro. Rahauro is a tauren attendant found on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, faithfully serving the elder crone Magatha Grimtotem. Acting on her behalf, he recruits brave adventurers to venture into the volcanic depths of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar. He coordinates efforts to retaliate against the hostile troggs and recover missing possessions belonging to his mistress's fallen agents. Standing loyally near Magatha Grimtotem on the high terrace of Elder Rise, Rahauro acts as her direct intermediary. Magatha often operates through trusted underlings rather than soiling her own hooves with public recruitment. When reports emerge of wild creatures swarming beneath the orcish capital, it is Rahauro who handles the logistical details, dispatching Horde mercenaries to deal with the uprising.

Raleigh Andrean. Raleigh Andrean is a Forsaken resident of the Undercity. His requests reveal a callous attitude toward his former human life and those he once knew. Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Raleigh Andrean lived an ordinary human life, married to a woman named Deliah and keeping company with his friend Valdred Moray. Like countless others, he fell when the Scourge tore through the kingdom, only to be raised as a mindless thrall in service to the Lich King. He regained his free will following the shattering of the Ner'zhul's grip and Sylvanas Windrunner's uprising, taking his place among the Forsaken in the Undercity.

Randis. Randis is a spirited young human orphan under the care of Orphan Matron Nightingale at the orphanage in Cathedral Square. During Children's Week, he eagerly accompanies willing adventurers across the Alliance's territories to take in sights far beyond the city walls. Residing in the orphanage near Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Randis is one of many children left without family in the wake of the realm's persistent conflicts. When the annual Children's Week arrives, Orphan Matron Nightingale entrusts sympathetic heroes with a whistle to take him under their wing. Full of youthful curiosity and nonstop questions, Randis dreams of adventuring, asks endless riddles, and boldly declares that when he grows up, he wants to be the king of Stormwind.

Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea. Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea is a seasoned night elf sentry stationed in the coastal town of Auberdine. From her post near the town watch, she directs local defense efforts across Darkshore, dispatching travelers to eliminate lurking threats and investigate strange coastal phenomena. As Darkshore grapples with rising corruption and hostile incursions, Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea coordinates vital scout work from Auberdine. She keeps a watchful eye over the surrounding wilderness, relying on capable adventurers to maintain the perimeter and safeguard night elf holdings along the fog-shrouded coast.

Rau Cliffrunner. Rau Cliffrunner is a tauren scout and scholar stationed high atop Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Dedicated to protecting his people from regional threats, he studies the history and origins of the hostile Galak centaur through their ancient relics. Working closely with allies in Thunder Bluff, Rau coordinates ventures into dangerous enemy strongholds across the canyon. Perched on the perilous bluffs of Freewind Post, Rau Cliffrunner maintains a watchful eye over the sweeping, sun-scorched expanse of Thousand Needles. The tauren outpost serves as a crucial Horde sanctuary in an otherwise hostile territory teeming with ferocious predators, quilboar, and aggressive centaur clans. Rau acts as both an outpost organizer and a dedicated investigator, keen on neutralizing emerging threats before they can overwhelm the vulnerable mesa settlements.

Razzle Sprysprocket. Razzle Sprysprocket is a gnomish engineer residing in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. Known for his technical tinkering alongside Ozzie Togglevolt, he enlists travelers to help salvage disrupted gnomish machinery and components around the snowy hills. Following the tragedy at Gnomeregan, Razzle Sprysprocket found refuge among the snowdrifts of Dun Morogh, setting up his workshop in Kharanos. With a knack for delicate mechanical parts, Razzle works alongside fellow engineer Ozzie Togglevolt. Their efforts frequently involve recovering gyro-mechanisms and cog assemblies that were lost or scavenged during the flight from their irradiated homeland.

Red Jack Flint. Red Jack Flint is a seasoned human mariner stationed within Menethil Keep in Menethil Harbor. A member of the crew of the vessel Maiden's Virtue, he serves as a point of contact for travelers seeking passage or contacts across the sea toward Kalimdor. Found inside the stone walls of Menethil Keep, Red Jack Flint is an experienced seafarer tied to the harbor's maritime trade. As part of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue, he navigates the dangerous sea routes linking the marshlands of Khaz Modan with distant shores. Rather than staying confined to naval routine, Flint directs capable adventurers to allies across the Great Sea, including contacts in Kalimdor like Fiora Longears.

Rejold Barleybrew. Rejold Barleybrew is a master dwarven brewer stationed in the lakeside settlement of Brewnall Village in western Dun Morogh. Devoted to perfecting hearty mountain spirits, he regularly enlists travelers to gather regional ingredients and test his potent recipes across the snowy valley. In Dun Morogh, brewing is treated not merely as trade, but as a defining art form. Rejold Barleybrew embodies this tradition from Brewnall Village, an outpost nestled near the frozen lake of the Iceflow River. Rather than settling for common tavern swill, Rejold continually refines his blends, seeking rare hops, mountain minerals, and pristine ice water to produce stouts capable of warming the stoutest dwarven warriors.

Rema Schneider. Rema Schneider is a human citizen who works out of the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop in Stormwind City. Situated along the quiet waterways between the major districts, she frequently assists local shopkeepers and artisans with trade deliveries. Tucked away in the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, positioned just west of the stone bridge leading across to Cathedral Square, Rema Schneider manages the daily needs of urban trade. Like many skilled artisans and assistants across the city, her work keeps cloth and finished garments moving between local craftsmen, relying on helpful couriers to carry supplies between workshops.

Remulos. Keeper Remulos is a demigod son of Cenarius and the venerable protector of Moonglade. Alongside Archdruid Fandral Staghelm and Hamuul Runetotem, he helps guide the Cenarion Circle in the absence of his fallen father and the sleeping Malfurion Stormrage. Unlike Staghelm, Remulos prioritizes the broader balance of nature over night elven isolationism. Keeper Remulos is an immortal keeper of the grove, bearing the lower body of a great stag and the antlered torso of an ancient dryad-father. He watches over Moonglade, the sacred sanctuary of Azeroth's druids nestled north of Mount Hyjal. While Malfurion Stormrage remains trapped in the Emerald Dream, Remulos provides divine authority and counsel to the mortals of the Cenarion Circle. He remains deeply invested in healing Azeroth's scars, offering aid to druids pursuing their sacred rites around Lake Elune'ara.

Remy "Two Times". Remy "Two Times" is a human merchant currently residing in the village of Goldshire. Originally hailing from the Redridge Mountains, he is easily recognized by his peculiar habit of repeating the ends of his sentences. He maintains business interests across Elwynn Forest, trading goods and paying adventurers for raw materials like gold dust. Operating out of Goldshire, Remy "Two Times" is an enterprising trader who made his way west from the rugged terrain of the Redridge Mountains. True to his moniker, Remy possesses a distinctive verbal tick: repeating the final words of his sentences, usually twice. Despite his comical speech pattern, he remains a savvy merchant looking to turn a profit amid the growing troubles in Elwynn Forest, readily striking deals with traveling adventurers.

Renato Gallina. Renato Gallina is an energetic barker found promoting business in Stormwind City's bustling Trade District. A member of the Gallina winemaking family, his job is to drum up patrons and direct thirsty travelers to the family winery nestled along the city canals. Standing amidst the busy stalls of the Trade District, Renato Gallina spends his days calling out to passers-by, boldly proclaiming that his family sells the finest vintages in all of Stormwind. His family operates the Gallina Winery located nearby along the Canals, and Renato serves as their public promoter, handing out pamphlets that passers-by can bring to his sister Suzetta at the shop for a free bottle of wine.

Innkeeper Renee. Innkeeper Renee runs the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, offering shelter, food, and drink to the Forsaken and to Horde travelers passing through Tirisfal Glades. Renee keeps the Gallows' End Tavern, the inn at the heart of Brill. Behind her counter she sells food, drink and general goods, and she welcomes weary newcomers to rest their bones, remarking that the Forsaken certainly do have huge appetites. For the undead of Tirisfal, her tavern is a cozy little place where victims of the plague try to make their way in the world.

Renzik "The Shiv". Renzik "The Shiv" is a goblin operative and the trusted second-in-command of SI:7, stationed inside their headquarters in Stormwind City's Old Town. He serves Spymaster Mathias Shaw faithfully, directing the new rogue recruits sent to him from across the Alliance. Renzik keeps the story of his past to himself. What Stormwind knows is that this goblin found his way into SI:7 and now stands as Spymaster Mathias Shaw's second in command. He is short on patience and pleasantries, greeting new recruits by asking whether they are ready to get to work or need a nap first.

Rethiel the Greenwarden. Rethiel the Greenwarden is an ancient, sentient bog beast residing in the Green Belt within the Wetlands. Deeply attuned to the natural balance of the marsh, he watches over the land and enlists travelers to cull threats that disrupt its harmony. Standing amidst the damp thickets of the Green Belt, Rethiel is a towering creature of moss, peat, and primal plant life. While many bog beasts in the marshlands wander aimlessly as aggressive predators, Rethiel possesses a rare, conscious awareness and a sorrowful voice. He perceives the wetlands not merely as murky terrain, but as a living ecosystem that currently cries out under the weight of foreign predation and corruption.

Rezlak. Rezlak is a goblin entrepreneur and member of the Tinkers' Union stationed along the dusty roads of Durotar south of Orgrimmar. He hires traveling adventurers to salvage his missing supplies and clear out the harpies preying on his supply caravans. Perched beside the canyon roads connecting Razor Hill to Orgrimmar, Rezlak represents the Tinkers' Union—a goblin syndicate focused on engineering, supply lines, and industrial pragmatism. Rezlak cares little for the factional tensions of Kalimdor so long as business runs smoothly. When the fierce Dustwind harpies raided his cargo caravans and made the supply routes unsafe, Rezlak stayed put, preferring to contract out the dangerous work of extermination and recovery to any passerby willing to turn a profit.

Rhahk'Zor. Rhahk'Zor is a hulking ogre serving as the head foreman within the Deadmines. Overseeing Edwin VanCleef's subterranean construction efforts, he keeps the Defias laborers and miners in line through sheer brute force and heavy-handed discipline. Deep beneath the rolling hills of Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood has transformed the abandoned gold mines of Moonbrook into an underground fortress. Coordinating this sprawling construction requires harsh discipline, a role filled by the ogre Rhahk'Zor. Appointed as head foreman, he oversees the excavation crews and laborers, driving them forward to carve out tunnels and assemble VanCleef's secret projects.

Rhinag. Rhinag is an afflicted jungle troll of the Darkspear tribe, sheltering among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border. Weakened by the harsh venom of the region's scorpids, he relies entirely on passing travelers to secure him a timely remedy. While traversing the arid terrain of Durotar, Rhinag fell victim to the vicious sting of a local Venomtail Scorpid. Overwhelmed by the potent poison, he took shelter among the rocks near Durotar's northwestern border. Weakened and isolated, his survival hinges on anyone who happens by with the resolve to procure a venomtail antidote before the toxins take their final toll.

Ringo. Ringo is an unfortunate goblin explorer who ventured up the blistering heights of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Overwhelmed by the volcano's stifling heat and noxious vapors, he collapsed inside a cave, desperate for someone to help him back down. His close friend Spraggle Frock remains worried sick back at Marshal's Refuge. While goblins are known for braving hazardous environments in search of wealth or oddities, Fire Plume Ridge proves harsh even by their standards. Towering in the center of Un'Goro Crater, the active volcano spews ash, magma, and boiling steam. Ringo climbed about halfway up the southern face before the suffocating heat finally proved too much for him. Leaving his belongings scattered just outside, he crawled into a cave to shelter from the sweltering atmosphere, completely incapacitated by heat exhaustion.

Rivern Frostwind. Rivern Frostwind is a night elf riding instructor stationed high atop Frostsaber Rock in northern Winterspring. Accompanied by his frost tiger companion Glacier, he watches over the native wintersabers and trains riders deemed worthy by his order. Only the most dedicated champions of the Alliance are granted the honor of riding one of his prized mounts. Perched on the icy promontory of Frostsaber Rock, Rivern Frostwind oversees the breeding and stewardship of the legendary Winterspring frostsaber. While nightsabers roam the lush forests of Teldrassil and Ashenvale, their sub-arctic cousins are bred to endure the bitter cold of northern Kalimdor. Rivern acts as a gatekeeper for these majestic predators. He demands that outsiders prove their commitment to preserving the beasts—gathering fresh meat from the tundra, clearing out Winterfall furbolgs, and driving back rampaging frost giants—before he will even consider entrusting one of the sabers to them.

Roetten Stonehammer. Roetten Stonehammer is an enterprising dwarf found wandering the Library in Ironforge's Hall of Explorers. Representing the interests of Reclaimers Inc., he organizes expeditions and recruits adventurers to handle salvage operations in distant lands like Desolace. Amid the ancient tomes and dust of the Hall of Explorers' Library, Roetten Stonehammer keeps his eye on matters of practical recovery. Operating on behalf of Reclaimers Inc., Roetten connects daring mercenaries with lucrative salvage contracts across Kalimdor. Rather than digging purely for historical curiosity, his associates look to reclaim valuable cargo, wreckage, and rare reagents from perilous frontiers like the rugged wastes of Desolace.

Rorian the Dayseeker. Rorian the Dayseeker is an elder Skyborne figure situated in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. He oversees the initiation of young fledglings as they discover their calling, step into maturity, and attune themselves to the natural elements of their homeland. Under his watchful guidance, newcomers learn the fundamentals of survival, tradition, and service to their community. Within the serene confines of Thendal Village on Zephras Isle, Rorian the Dayseeker stands as one of the primary mentors for the fledgling Skyborne. Revered for his experience and calm wisdom, Rorian directs youth during their crucial transition into adulthood. It is under his instruction that initiates undertake their traditional rite of passage, marking their readiness to defend and support their island home.

Royal Historian Archesonus. Royal Historian Archesonus is a dwarven scholar serving King Magni Bronzebeard within Ironforge's High Seat. Renowned for her scholarly works documenting recent catastrophes in the northern human kingdoms, she also directs research into ancient dwarven tragedies, notably the scorched remains of the Dark Iron kingdom. Stationed steps from King Magni Bronzebeard's throne in the High Seat, Royal Historian Archesonus maintains historical records on behalf of the Ironforge crown. Her academic gaze extends well beyond the Khaz Modan mountains. She authored 'The Fall of Lordaeron and the Scouring of the Eastweald' as well as 'On Plagues, Curses, and Blights,' tracking the horrific collapse of humanity's northern realm under the Scourge. Rather than hiding from dark histories, Archesonus approaches disasters methodically, seeking to record the truth of ruinous magic and political collapse.

Ruga Ragetotem. Ruga Ragetotem is a veteran tauren warrior stationed at Camp Taurajo in the southern Barrens. Serving as a mentor to promising Horde fighters, he tests their mettle against the strange silithid infestation emerging nearby before sending them toward custom armor. Standing watch over Camp Taurajo, Ruga Ragetotem helps train emerging warriors looking to prove their strength in Kalimdor. Recognizing the sudden, unsettling emergence of insectoid silithid carving hives into the Field of Giants to the south, Ruga sets a trial for young fighters to hunt the beasts and sever their antennae. Those who endure the ordeal earn his respect and a recommendation to the renowned armorsmith Thun'grim Firegaze.

Rutgar Glyphshaper. Rutgar Glyphshaper is a dwarven archaeologist stationed at the Bronzebeard Encampment in the southern reaches of Silithus. As a member of Brann Bronzebeard's expedition, he studies ancient silithid relics and runes, striving to uncover the mystery of the hives even after Brann wanders off into the desert. Rutgar Glyphshaper traveled to Silithus under the leadership of Brann Bronzebeard to investigate the vast silithid hives and unearth lost relics buried beneath the desert wastes. Establishing their base at the Bronzebeard Encampment south of Cenarion Hold, Rutgar and his companions frequently ventured directly into the bug hives to harvest inscribed stones and runic artifacts, often cooperating with Cenarion night elf researchers.

Ruul Eagletalon. Ruul Eagletalon is a tauren resident of Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore. Stationed near the settlement's perimeter, he keeps a watchful eye on the local wildlife, particularly the aggressive Windfury harpies encroaching upon tauren lands. Ruul Eagletalon stands guard in Bloodhoof Village, tending to the security of the settlement as young braves arrive from Camp Narache. While Mulgore is a peaceful homeland compared to the arid wastes of the Barrens, territorial predators and hostile creatures continually press against the pastures. Ruul concerns himself with threats roaming the nearby plains, notably directing capable travelers to confront the savage Windfury harpies who prey on unwary nomads and game.

Ruul Snowhoof. Ruul Snowhoof is a tauren druid held captive inside Thistlefur Hold in northern Ashenvale. Trapped in his bear form within a crude cage, he relies on Horde adventurers to break him out and guide him to safety. Ruul Snowhoof ventured into northern Ashenvale only to fall into the clutches of the corrupt Thistlefur furbolgs. When captured, he assumed the shape of a mighty bear—a guise his captors entirely mistook for an actual wild beast. Instead of slaying him outright, the furbolgs locked him inside a wooden cage deep within Thistlefur Hold, leaving him to slowly starve. Weakened and unable to safely drop his form or fight his way out alone, Ruul waits for allies of the Horde to spring his lock, fight off his jailers, and clear a path through the den so he can return to his sister, Yama Snowhoof, at Splintertree Post.

Rwag. Rwag is the orc rogue trainer stationed in the Den, tucked within Durotar's Valley of Trials. He instructs newly arrived orcs and trolls in the arts of stealth, subterfuge, and dirty fighting under the watchful gaze of the Horde. Operating deep within the cave known as the Den, Rwag trains fledgling rogues, cutpurses, and thieves before they step out into the wider world of Durotar. While the new Horde champions martial honor and battlefield valor, Rwag understands that subtlety, poisons, and a well-placed dagger remain invaluable tools for survival in an unforgiving desert. He keeps a sharp eye on Valley business and harbors deep suspicions regarding the dark practitioners also sheltering in the cave, particularly the warlock Nartok.

Saelienne. Innkeeper Saelienne manages the inn situated on the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. She provides weary travelers and local artisans with food, drink, and a peaceful hearthstone retreat in the heart of the night elven capital. Situated amidst the bustling workshops and trade stalls of the Craftsmen's Terrace, Innkeeper Saelienne offers a calm respite for both residents and visitors to Darnassus. As a keeper of the hearth, she caters to adventurers arriving from across Kalimdor and beyond, serving staple night elven refreshments alongside goods brought into the city port. Her establishment serves as a primary gathering place for tradesfolk seeking rest after long hours at the forge or loom.

High Inquisitor Whitemane. Whitemane is the High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade, presiding over the Cathedral of the Scarlet Monastery. A powerful priestess of the Holy Light, her consuming hatred for the undead drives the Crusade's uncompromising zealotry. Together with Scarlet Commander Renault Mograine, she directs the order's military and ideological campaigns across Lordaeron. Rising rapidly through the Scarlet Crusade's hierarchy, Whitemane became its High Inquisitor and took command of the Scarlet Monastery's grand Cathedral. Renowned for her fearsome mastery of Holy magic, she has become one of the Crusade's foremost symbols through her absolute conviction, wielding the Light as an unrelenting weapon against any deemed unclean.

Salma Saldean. Salma Saldean is a hardy Westfall homesteader who tends Saldean's Farm alongside her husband, Farmer Saldean. In a region overrun by bandits and abandoned by Stormwind, she keeps her door open and provides warm meals to travelers in exchange for a little help around the homestead. While neighboring homesteads have been ransacked and burned by the Defias Brotherhood, the Saldeans manage to keep their hearth lit. Salma greets travelers with a warm demeanor and a hearty pot on the stove, always on the lookout for capable wanderers willing to assist around the farmstead.

Sara Balloo. Sara Balloo is a grieving dwarven widow residing in the Military Ward of Ironforge. She spends her days mourning her late husband, Sully Balloo, clinging to any remnant or message left behind from his final days in service. Standing within the bustling Military Ward of Ironforge, Sara Balloo presents a somber contrast to the clatter of weaponry and martial drills. Her husband, Sully Balloo, fell in battle far from home, leaving her alone with memories and lingering grief. For Sara, closure arrives only through recovered words—a final letter carrying Sully's devotion across the mountains from the scene of his demise.

Sara Timberlain. Sara Timberlain is a skilled tailor residing at the Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. Known for her resourceful needlework with salvaged fabrics, she assists the war effort by stitching cloth and leather armaments for the Stormwind Army. Situated outside a small cottage on the western edge of the Eastvale Logging Camp, Sara Timberlain works tirelessly with needle and thread amidst the ambient noise of felling axes. Despite the remote nature of Eastvale and the looming threat of prowling wolves and murlocs, she provides hospitality and vital craftwork to travelers. Her talent for turning scraps of linen and salvaged bandanas into durable gear has earned her official recognition, securing commissions to supply protective cloth and leather armaments directly to Stormwind's military forces.

Scarlet Commander Mograine. Scarlet Commander Mograine serves as the military leader garrisoned inside the Cathedral of the Scarlet Monastery. A zealous paladin of the Scarlet Crusade, he defends the chapel alongside High Inquisitor Whitemane. Both the Horde and Alliance target him to disrupt the zealots threatening Tirisfal Glades and the surrounding lands. Stationed within the grand Crusader's Chapel at the heart of the Scarlet Monastery, Scarlet Commander Mograine commands the standing garrison of the Scarlet Crusade. He wields the holy power of a paladin with ferocious dedication, relying on retribution, divine shields, and stunning blows to shatter any whom the Crusade deems corrupted or unclean.

Scooty. Scooty is a goblin engineer operating out of the bustling pirate port of Booty Bay. Proclaiming himself a master of engineering, he maintains a delicate transponder setup linked directly to an experimental teleporter in the fallen city of Gnomeregan. His contraptions offer Horde operatives a direct, if perilous, technological bypass right into the heart of Dun Morogh. Operating amid the wharves and workshops of Booty Bay, Scooty holds court as one of the Steamwheedle Cartel's most ambitious tinkerers. While typical goblins obsess over gunpowder and explosives, Scooty turned his attention to instantaneous molecular transport. By calibrating complex transponder systems, he manages a direct operational link to a teleportation pad situated inside Gnomeregan. Horde forces looking to breach the subterranean gnome stronghold rely heavily on Scooty's tinkering to bypass treacherous Alliance territory altogether.

Scout Riell. Scout Riell is a vigilant lookout stationed atop the watchtower at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. Serving the local People's Militia, she watches the surrounding plains for Defias activity and enlists adventurers to hunt down the masked outlaws. Perched high above Sentinel Hill, Scout Riell keeps watch over a region besieged by banditry and harvest golems. With Stormwind's royal army absent and the crown refusing aid, local defense falls entirely to the People's Militia. From her vantage point atop the stone tower, Riell tracks the brazen movements of the Defias Brotherhood and gathers proof of their crimes, calling on passing travelers to strip the bandits of their iconic red silk bandanas.

Argent Guard Thaelrid. Argent Guard Thaelrid is a wounded night elf scout sent by the Argent Dawn into the submerged ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. Trapped near the Pool of Ask'ar, he bears witness to the dark alliance taking root between the naga and the Twilight's Hammer cult. When strange reports trickled out of the Zoram Strand concerning foul rites deep beneath the sea, the Argent Dawn took interest. Dedicated to watching for rising evils and unnatural corruption across Azeroth, the order dispatched Scout Thaelrid to slip inside Blackfathom Deeps. His mission was simple: assess the depth of the threat, observe the movements within the flooded temple, and report back so the Dawn could decide where aid was most desperately needed.

Searn Firewarder. Searn Firewarder is a Darkspear troll shaman trainer stationed inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. He assists developing shamans across the Horde, directing them toward the trials needed to commune with the elemental spirits of fire, water, and air. Standing within the fortified walls of Grommash Hold alongside the Horde's high command, Searn Firewarder serves as an elemental guide for aspiring shamans. While many Darkspear trolls commune with the spirits through witch doctors and voodoo rituals, Searn represents the bond troll shamans forge directly with the living elements of Kalimdor. He acts as an intermediary, directing initiates toward the far-flung mentors and rites required to earn the Call of Fire, Call of Water, and Call of Air.

Seer Graytongue. Seer Graytongue is a venerable tauren elder and spiritual guide residing on Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Stationed near Camp Narache, he tests young braves undertaking their earliest tribal trials. Through rituals such as the Rite of Strength, he ensures that the youth honor the Earthmother before stepping into the wider world. Seer Graytongue makes his home atop Red Cloud Mesa, serving as an early instructor for aspiring tauren braves and spellweavers. As young adventurers set forth from Camp Narache, Graytongue oversees critical steps of their sacred passage, including the Rites of the Earthmother. By testing their resolve against the harsh plains and dangerous beasts of Mulgore, he instills the virtues of honor, patience, and reverence that every true tauren must carry into adulthood.

Seer Ravenfeather. Seer Ravenfeather is a tauren shaman instructor stationed at Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa. She guides fledging spiritualists through their early trials, helping them attune to the voices of the spirits and the land of Mulgore. Standing within the quiet shelters of Camp Narache, Seer Ravenfeather serves as a patient teacher for young tauren called to walk the shamanic path. The Red Cloud Mesa is a sacred proving ground, and Ravenfeather ensures that novice practitioners understand their duties before venturing into the wider expanses of Mulgore. She instructs them in the foundational rites needed to commune with elemental forces and honor the Earth Mother.

Seereth Stonebreak. Seereth Stonebreak is an orc shaman who serves the Horde by monitoring the disturbances unsettling the land. Camped near the Greatwood Vale on the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens, she directs travelers to address environmental ruin, rogue machines, and rising tensions in Kalimdor. Seereth Stonebreak is an orc dedicated to the harmony of the elements and the protection of Horde territories. Sent to Stonetalon after the land's spirits cried out against the goblins' plunder, she keeps her camp near the Greatwood Vale and maintains a vigilant eye over the landscape. Rather than retreat into despair, she uses her spiritual insight and knowledge of the wild frontier to guide adventurers against looming dangers.

Senani Thunderheart. Senani Thunderheart is a tauren huntress stationed at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale, just north of the Barrens. Serving the Horde, she tests the mettle of passing travelers by challenging them to pursue the fierce wild predators that roam the ancient forest. Through her trials, hunters prove their skill while thinning the deadly beasts prowling near Horde territory. Found keeping camp at Splintertree Post, Senani Thunderheart represents the hunting traditions of the tauren amid the shadowed groves of Ashenvale. Far from the open plains of Mulgore, she directs Horde adventurers to test their tracking and combat prowess against the forest's apex beasts. She views the hunt as both an honorable challenge and a necessary ritual to survive in an untamed, contested land.

Senator Mehr Stonehallow. Senator Mehr Stonehallow is an Ironforge politician and member of the Explorers' League stationed at the Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh. Rather than debating policy in the capital, he has traveled to the front lines to personally oversee the containment of the local trogg infestation. He enlists eager adventurers to cull the beasts before they overrun the quarry completely. While most members of the Ironforge Senate spend their days safely sequestered within the great stone halls of the capital, Senator Mehr Stonehallow prefers direct action. As a dwarf dedicated both to governance and the historical pursuits of the Explorers' League, he understands the practical dangers facing the realm. When vicious Rockjaw troggs began clawing out of the deep rock in Gol'Bolar Quarry, Stonehallow made the journey to the mining pit himself. Convinced that bureaucratic posturing will not save the workers, he offers bounties to capable travelers to eradicate the aggressive troggs and reclaim the quarry.

Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser. Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser is a goblin researcher working from Gadgetzan in Tanaris. He investigates disruptions around the local water supply and sends adventurers to look into the disappearance of Scrimshank.

Senir Whitebeard. Senir Whitebeard is a dwarven dignitary and field agent stationed outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Serving as a special envoy from the Senate of Ironforge, he is tasked with monitoring the growing threats encircling Dun Morogh. His mission centers on evaluating the Frostmane troll offensive and reporting their movements directly back to the dwarven leadership. While most travelers visit Kharanos for its bustling inn and famous stout, Senir Whitebeard is here on official business. As a representative sent directly by the Senate of Ironforge, his presence highlights how seriously the high halls take the destabilization of Dun Morogh. He serves as an essential bridge between local scouts facing danger on the snowy frontier and the legislators arguing policy behind the city's stone gates.

Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak. Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak is a night elf guardian stationed within the serene groves of the Oracle Glade on Teldrassil. Charged with monitoring the sacred balance of the northern boughs, she keeps a wary watch over the glade's enchanted waters and woodland wildlife. Arynia Cloudsbreak serves the Sentinel army in one of the most secluded and mystical reaches of Teldrassil: the Oracle Glade. Amid ancient trees and ethereal springs, she carries out her watch far from the bustling avenues of Darnassus, ensuring the sanctity of the wilderness remains undisturbed.

Sentinel Aynasha. Sentinel Aynasha is an operative of the night elven Sentinels serving in the wild borders of Darkshore. Tasked with scouting enemy movements and carrying critical intelligence, she regularly faces peril against hostile forces threatening northern Kalimdor. As a scout and archer for the Sentinels, Aynasha is deployed to the dangerous frontiers where night elven lands clash with hostile incursions. Carrying out stealth missions and bearing urgent dispatches across rugged terrain, she relies on her marksmanship and survival instincts to evade enemy patrols and survive deep within contested territory.

Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze. Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze is a night elf guardian stationed in Auberdine along the misty coast of Darkshore. Operating from the upper floor of a lodge across the bridge, she monitors growing regional threats and directs travelers toward pressing concerns in the wilderness. While many Sentinels patrol the foggy coastline and woodlands directly, Elissa Starbreeze coordinates defensive efforts from Auberdine. Stationed on the upper level of the building just northeast across the bridge from the town inn, she stays alert to unusual disturbances in Darkshore. Her tasks frequently point adventurers toward remote points of interest, including the mysterious Tower of Althalaxx looming far to the north, ensuring that shadowy incursions do not take the coastal settlement unawares.

Sentinel Farsong. Sentinel Farsong is a night elf sentinel stationed at Silverwing Grove in Ashenvale. Serving as a crucial liaison for the Silverwing Sentinels, she coordinates intelligence and combat efforts against the encroaching Warsong Outriders in Warsong Gulch. Standing vigil within Silverwing Grove, Sentinel Farsong is deeply involved in the defense of Ashenvale's southern border. With the Warsong clan continuously harvesting lumber and pushing deeper into ancestral night elf territories, she mobilizes Alliance champions to strike at Warsong Outriders and ensures field reports reach Silverwing command. Her duties center on rallying volunteers to check the Horde's territorial expansion and preserve the sacred woods.

Sentinel Onaeya. Sentinel Onaeya is a night elf guardian stationed at Maestra's Post in northwestern Ashenvale, near the border with Darkshore. Tasked with holding the line against encroaching perils, she rallies capable Alliance adventurers to safeguard the forest and aid fellow sentinels. Maestra's Post serves as a critical wayside outpost along the road from Darkshore into the dense, contested canopy of Ashenvale. Sentinel Onaeya stands guard outside the settlement's main lodge, keeping a vigilant watch over travelers and coordinating defensive actions. Between hostile wildlife, corrupting forces, and border tensions, sentinels like Onaeya represent the first line of defense for night elf settlements in the region.

Sentinel Selarin. Sentinel Selarin is a night elf scout dispatched to the coastal settlement of Auberdine. Acting as an emissary for the defenders of Ashenvale, she seeks reinforcements to help stem the rising perils threatening the ancient forest. As tensions and dark threats mount across Ashenvale, the garrison there has found its resources stretched to the breaking point. Under the direction of Raene Wolfrunner, Sentinel Selarin traveled north along the forest road into Darkshore. Her mission was straightforward: seek out Terenthis in Auberdine and request assistance from the sentinels and scouts stationed on the coast.

Sentinel Thenysil. Sentinel Tara Thenysil is a night elf sentinel stationed in Astranaar within the ancient forest of Ashenvale. Vigilant over the surrounding wilderness, she keeps close tabs on military operations in the region and coordinates scouts watching neighboring territories. Her attention is particularly focused on allied movements pushing south into the contested Stonetalon Mountains. From her post in the fortified settlement of Astranaar, Sentinel Thenysil helps secure Ashenvale against growing hostility. Night elf holdings throughout the region face relentless encroachment, making communications between distant outposts vital. While much of the local garrison focuses directly on defending the forest road, Thenysil directs Alliance volunteers beyond Ashenvale's borders to ensure distant allies remain supported.

Sentinel Tysha Moonblade. Sentinel Tysha Moonblade is a night elf scout stationed along the main road of Darkshore, just west of the ancient ruins of Ameth'Aran. Tasked with patrolling the troubled coastal wilderness, she directs travelers and recruits aid to investigate the restless spirits haunting the shattered elven settlements nearby. Standing sentinel along the overgrown highway of Darkshore, Tysha Moonblade keeps a vigilant eye over an increasingly unstable land. Directly to her east lie the haunted remnants of Ameth'Aran, where cursed Highborne ghosts and malevolent banshees linger among ancient stone pillars. Recognizing that Auberdine's limited defenses are stretched thin by threats across the coast, Tysha enlists capable adventurers passing by to uncover the history behind Ameth'Aran's tragic fall and put down the restless dead.

Sentinel Velene Starstrike. Sentinel Velene Starstrike is a night elf guardian stationed at Silverwind Refuge in central Ashenvale. Tasked with protecting the sanctuary and the surrounding waters, she confronts encroaching unnatural threats such as rogue elementals and foul sorcerers. Her vigilance helps safeguard the ancient woodland from corrupting magical interference. Stationed beside the clear waters of Mystral Lake, Sentinel Velene Starstrike maintains a watchful vigil from Silverwind Refuge. Like many night elf sentinels scattered throughout Ashenvale, her primary duty is preserving the balance of the forest and repelling threats to elven sanctuaries. The serene grove serves as a vital rest stop for travelers traversing the central woods, making her presence essential to the area's ongoing safety.

Serge Hinott. Serge Hinott is a Forsaken alchemist stationed in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Working closely alongside Apothecary Lydon, he assists the Royal Apothecary Society with brewing concoctions, antidotes, and reagents essential to the Forsaken war effort. Positioned beside Apothecary Lydon in the fortified settlement of Tarren Mill, Serge Hinott plays a crucial supporting role for Forsaken operations in Hillsbrad Foothills. While Lydon focuses on broader chemical development and aggressive plague research against neighboring human settlements like Southshore, Hinott manages specialized brewing tasks. His expertise includes preparing restorative salves and critical antidotes required when field agents and scouts encounter dangerous poisons and toxic mishaps.

Shadow Priest Allister. Shadow Priest Allister is a Forsaken priest stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. Overseeing intelligence and tactical efforts in the region, he coordinates operations to monitor Dalaran's wizards and secure the borders of Lordaeron for the Dark Lady. Operating out of the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister directs Forsaken reconnaissance throughout Silverpine Forest. From this central crypt settlement, he tracks nearby threats ranging from renegade humans and beastly incursions to the arcane machinations unfolding around Dalaran.

Shadow Priest Sarvis. Shadow Priest Sarvis stands inside the ruined chapel of Deathknell, serving as one of the primary guides for newly awakened Forsaken. He introduces fresh corpses to their grim reality, directing them to purge mindless undead and gather intelligence on local threats. Under Lady Sylvanas's banner, Sarvis works tirelessly to shape bewildered undead into disciplined servants of the Forsaken. Within the shadowy chapel of Deathknell, Shadow Priest Sarvis waits for those who have just clawed their way out of the grave. The awakening of a Forsaken soul is jarring and horrific, with many immediately losing their minds to mindless frenzy or despondency. Sarvis acts as an anchor, giving purpose to the newly risen. He assigns new recruits to put down the shambling, mindless corpses roaming the cemetery and directs them to secure Deathknell's borders against the encroaching Scourge.

Shael'dryn. Shael'dryn is an inquisitive dryad residing beside the Moonwell of Purity, east of Iris Lake in Ashenvale. She serves as a vital contact for night elf scouts investigating forest corruption. She plays a pivotal role in aiding Astranaar's sentinels with cleansing relics to combat demonic and foul influences spreading across the wilderness. Stationed beside the Moonwell of Purity, Shael'dryn keeps watch alongside the night elf sentinels guarding the eastern approaches of the forest. When corruption surfaces among the local wildlife or tainted relics threaten the land's harmony, her deep natural understanding allows her to guide adventurers through the steps required to restore spiritual balance.

Shanda. Shanda is a night elf priestess and mentor located within the hollow trunk of Aldrassil in Shadowglen. Serving the Sisterhood of Elune, she instructs novice night elf priests in the fundamental prayers, wards, and rites of the Moon Goddess. Her guidance helps fledgling acolytes balance the light of Elune with their duties in defending Teldrassil. Standing within the tranquil sanctuary of Aldrassil, Shanda serves as one of the first spiritual guides for young night elves dedicated to Elune. While the druids tend to the waking roots and boughs of Teldrassil, priestesses like Shanda ensure that the spiritual heart of the Kaldorei remains tethered to the White Lady. She instructs new initiates on channeling lunar grace for healing and protective wards, preparing them to face the corruption creeping into the boughs of the World Tree.

Shandris Feathermoon. Shandris Feathermoon is the General of the Sentinel Army and, for ten thousand years, Tyrande Whisperwind's right hand. She now commands night elf military forces throughout Kalimdor from Feathermoon Stronghold on Sardor Isle off the coast of Feralas. Shandris Feathermoon is one of the oldest defenders of the night elves. For ten thousand years she has served at Tyrande Whisperwind's side as the high priestess's right hand among the Sentinels, through the long vigil that followed the Sundering.

Shari Stilwell. Shari Stilwell is a Forsaken paladin trainer stationed in the settlement of Brill within Tirisfal Glades. Bearing a surname shared with notable figures in the Eastern Kingdoms, she instructs Forsaken who take up the mantle of holy warriors. Her presence marks a rare and unconventional discipline among the undead under the Banshee Queen. Found among the blight-touched buildings of Brill, Shari Stilwell stands out as a mentor to Forsaken holy warriors. While the holy Light is excruciating to the undead, Shari guides fledgling Forsaken who endure that agonizing path. She aids newcomers seeking their footing in Tirisfal Glades through their early training and adjustments, offering guidance to those looking to secure a place within the Forsaken kingdom.

Shelene Rhobart. Shelene Rhobart is a Forsaken leatherworking trainer stationed along the road in Tirisfal Glades. Operating out of a Deathguard waystation, she supplies cured hides and leathercraft training to support the Forsaken's military and logistical efforts across the blighted lands. Shelene Rhobart plies her trade at a Deathguard waystation, an outpost situated southeast of Brill along the main road toward the ruins of Lordaeron. Even in undeath, practical crafts remain essential for survival and war. Shelene works with animal pelts collected from the prowling beasts of Tirisfal, refining tough hides into armor, straps, and field gear to supply local Forsaken patrols contending with both the Scourge and Scarlet crusaders.

Shenthul. Shenthul is a jungle troll rogue trainer based in the shadowy subterranean reaches of the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. As an operative of the Shattered Hand, he orchestrates espionage operations across Kalimdor and initiates rising rogues into the guild's covert ranks. Tucked away inside the murky depths of the Cleft of Shadow, Shenthul serves as one of the Horde's foremost rogue mentors. While the warriors and shamans above march openly across the red dust of Durotar, Shenthul trains those who prefer stealth, ambush, and subterfuge. Under his tutelage, initiates master essential fieldcraft and lethal arts, learning to operate within the unforgiving politics and harsh wilderness of Kalimdor.

Shindrell Swiftfire. Shindrell Swiftfire is a night elf sentinel and scout stationed in Astranaar, the heart of night elf operations in Ashenvale. Keenly aware of shifting perils along Kalimdor's western reaches, she directs capable Alliance adventurers toward gathering threats on the coastline and nearby mountain passes. Her duties make her an essential hub for coordinating local defense against emerging oceanic and wild menaces. From Astranaar's winding walkways, Shindrell Swiftfire serves as an alert observer of Ashenvale's broader frontiers. While the forest's Sentinels are constantly pressured by the Horde's logging incursions from the east and south, Shindrell keeps her eyes fixed on dangers that lie beyond the immediate woodland front. She acts as a vital liaison for travelers arriving from Darkshore or heading out toward the jagged ridges of Stonetalon, ensuring no sudden menace strikes Astranaar undefended from the flank.

Shoni the Shilent. Shoni the Shilent is an industrious gnome engineer stationed in Stormwind City's bustling Dwarven District. As commander of the Gnomeregan underground assault crew, she directs Alliance adventurers into the Deadmines to salvage the power supply of a goblin shredder, fuel for the machines she hopes will break a path back into Gnomeregan. Operating out of the smoky workshops of the Dwarven District, Shoni represents gnomish strategic ingenuity far from the lost halls of Gnomeregan. Her engineering plans are ambitious. With Gnomeregan in the hands of the troggs, Shoni is organizing an underground assault to retake it, and she sends operatives into the subterranean tunnels beneath Westfall for the parts her crew needs.

Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Mekgineer Thermaplugg is the self-proclaimed ruler of ruined Gnomeregan and the greatest traitor in gnomish history. Once the trusted chief advisor of High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, he orchestrated the catastrophic irradiation of the underground city in a twisted bid to seize power. Now thoroughly deranged and transformed into a leper gnome, he commands the irradiated halls from within a massive mechanical battle suit. Mekgineer Thermaplugg served for many years as chief advisor to High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, who trusted him completely. All the while, Thermaplugg secretly coveted the office of High Tinker. What finally drove him to betray that trust, whether power or wealth, not even Mekkatorque can say; the High Tinker can only note that Thermaplugg would have had both in time.

Sida. Sida is a dwarven resident of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Known for her estranged marriage to Einar Stonegrip, she spends her days in the port town while dealing with personal misadventures out in the surrounding marshes. Sida resides in the bustling Alliance port of Menethil Harbor, living apart from her husband, Einar Stonegrip. Their relationship is strained enough that Einar flatly refuses to travel to Menethil so long as Sida remains in town. Despite keeping to the coastal settlement, Sida occasionally ventures out into the dangers of the Wetlands, having recently suffered the misfortune of losing her personal bag during an expedition out toward Ironbeard's Tomb.

Sirra Von'Indi. Sirra Von'Indi is the resident historian of Darkshire, stationed within the town hall amid stacks of forgotten records. Versed in ancient languages and local history, he assists the township in deciphering mysterious documents and uncovering the dark past of Duskwood. Sirra Von'Indi serves as Darkshire's foremost scholar, keeping watch over the settlement's archives from inside the Darkshire Town Hall. While the town guard focuses on the immediate threats lurking in the woods, Sirra turns his attention to the written word, translating cryptic texts and preserving the fading history of Grand Hamlet before the shadow fell across the region.

Sister Aquinne. Sister Aquinne is an acolyte of Elune residing within the serene Temple Gardens of Darnassus. A novice priestess, she is studying under the Priesthood of Elune at the Temple of the Moon. Sister Aquinne has dedicated herself to the Priesthood of Elune in the night elf capital. Stationed in the tranquil Temple Gardens beneath the shadow of the Temple of the Moon, she continues her studies under the guidance of the High Priestess and elder sisters. When a once-great creature of the forest was in need of help, it was Aquinne who sent willing travelers to Priestess A'moora inside the temple to learn what had to be done.

Skorn Whitecloud. Skorn Whitecloud is an aging tauren hunter residing at Bloodhoof Village in the rolling plains of Mulgore. He guides young hunters in understanding their relationship with the land's predators and aids travelers who cross paths with Mulgore's lurking dangers. Living at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore, Skorn Whitecloud is an old hunter who now serves as an instructor in the ways of the hunt. His primary role is instilling respect for the wild creatures of the plains. He tests aspiring hunters by sending them after the claws of Mulgore's cunning flatland prowlers, to be shown to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff, ensuring that those who take up the bow or spear understand the balance between predator and prey.

Skuerto. Skuerto is a dwarven scout stationed at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands. Sent there by Archmage Malin alongside Apprentice Kryten, he aids the Alliance in the field, helping secure magical relics on Malin's behalf. Skuerto, a dwarf of Ironforge, works as a scout in the dangerous Arathi Highlands. Stationed alongside Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe, he works under the direction of Archmage Malin to recover arcane reagents and potent magical artifacts that once belonged to Malin's old master, Archmage Trelane.

Smith Argus. Smith Argus is the resident blacksmith and trainer stationed in the heart of Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. From his open-air forge near the Lion's Pride Inn, he repairs traveler gear, teaches novice smiths their fundamentals, and coordinates with craftsmen across southern Azeroth. His network ties Goldshire's local trade directly to logistical hubs like Stormwind and distant frontiers like Redridge. Situated just outside the Lion's Pride Inn, Smith Argus maintains one of the busiest anvils in Elwynn Forest. While Goldshire faces growing perils from nearby gnolls, kobolds, and Defias bandits, Argus keeps local militia and passing adventurers properly equipped. In addition to mending dented armor and forging sturdy implements, he serves as a blacksmithing trainer, initiating fledgling craftsmen into the fundamentals of working copper and bronze.

Sneed. Sneed is the Defias Brotherhood's goblin lumbermaster stationed deep within the Deadmines. Operating from the lumber chamber known as the Mast Room, he pilots a heavy shredder of his own design to process timber for Edwin VanCleef's secret juggernaut. While the Defias Brotherhood draws its core membership from disenfranchised human stonemasons and common laborers, building an ironclad warship requires specialist trades. Edwin VanCleef recruited Sneed specifically for his engineering know-how and ruthless goblin efficiency. Stationed in the Mast Room along the subterranean rail network, Sneed oversees the rapid felling, cutting, and shaping of timber needed to frame VanCleef's colossal dreadnaught.

Sneed's Shredder. Sneed's Shredder is an imposing mechanised lumber harvester stationed deep within the Deadmines. Piloted by the goblin taskmaster Sneed, this deadly machine acts as both heavy industrial machinery for Edwin VanCleef's shipwrights and a terrifying perimeter defender. Within the goblin-dominated foundry of the Deadmines, mechanical shredders serve a dual purpose: processing vast amounts of timber and lumber required for Edwin VanCleef's hidden juggernaut, and serving as armored shock engines against intruders. Sneed, the overseer of the lumber works, operates this modified mechanical beast directly, turning an oversized buzzsaw into an instrument of defense.

Solm Hargrin. Solm Hargrin is the rogue trainer stationed within Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. A pragmatic dwarf who values honor amongst thieves, he instructs novice dwarven and gnomish scoundrels in the art of subterfuge. He firmly believes that covert operatives will prove vital as geopolitical tensions simmer across Azeroth. Tucked away in the dwarven stronghold of Anvilmar, Solm Hargrin watches the snowy passes of Coldridge Valley with a keen, calculating eye. While Ironforge relies heavily on the brute strength of its mountaineers and warriors, Hargrin understands that some threats require a quieter, sharper touch. He welcomes budding rogues of both dwarven and gnomish heritage, deciphering coded missives for them and drilling them in essential techniques like Eviscerate. Above all, Hargrin champions a creed of professional loyalty and honor among thieves, preparing his pupils for an increasingly volatile world where subtle knives often shape the fate of nations.

Sprite Darter. Sprite Darters are small, iridescent faerie dragons native to the lush canopy of Feralas. Revered for their innate spiritual and magical qualities, they flit gracefully among the ancient trees. Recently, these rare creatures have become targets for local Grimtotem tauren who seek to capture and exploit them. Sprite Darters are elusive, winged woodland beasts native to the ancient forests of Feralas. Characterized by their gleaming, iridescent wings and mysterious spiritual essence, they embody the whimsical yet fierce magical ecology of Kalimdor's deep forests. Though generally peaceful and shy, their innate resistance to magical forces and natural power make them significant to those attuned to the wilderness.

Sprite Jumpsprocket. Sprite Jumpsprocket is an apprentice gnome engineer currently residing in the busy Dwarven District of Stormwind City. Like many gnomes who sought refuge following the fall of Gnomeregan, she pursues technical craft and innovation alongside her fellow tinkers. Her presence highlights the thriving community of dwarven and gnomish artisans who keep the capital city supplied with gears, gadgets, and mechanical expertise. In the soot-covered streets and bustling workshops of the Dwarven District, gnomes and dwarves work shoulder-to-shoulder forging metal and designing intricate contraptions. Sprite Jumpsprocket serves as an apprentice engineer in this vibrant hub. Having integrated into the kingdom's capital, apprentice tinkers like Sprite hone their craft under experienced masters, contributing their inventive minds to the everyday mechanisms and technological marvels of the Alliance.
